blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has become a widely adopted approach for aligning vision-language models (VLMs), yet the security of multimodal preference data remains largely unexplored. Existing preference poisoning attacks either corrupt explicit supervision signals or require visible triggers, making them detectable under human inspection. We introduce DPOison-VL, the first clean preference poisoning attack against VLM-DPO, which manipulates model alignment solely through imperceptible perturbations on a small fraction of training images, while leaving all prompts, responses, and preference annotations semantically intact. We formulate poison construction as a bilevel optimization and derive a gradient alignment surrogate that efficiently steers image perturbations toward the attacker-specified preference. We further introduce a preference displacement score for principled poison selection with provable first-order optimality under a fixed poison budget, and derive a sufficient condition for preference inversion. Extensive experiments across diverse attack tasks, different VLM architectures and scales, and baseline comparisons demonstrate that DPOison-VL achieves up to 98\% ASR with only 2\% poisoned data and exhibits cross-model transferability, while largely preserving clean accuracy and general utility. Our findings reveal a critical vulnerability in VLM-DPO, where imperceptible image perturbations in preference training data can silently redirect alignment.
blocks.zh: 直接偏好优化(DPO)已成为一种被广泛采纳的调和视觉语言模型(VLM)的方法,但多式联运偏好数据的安全性基本上仍未被探讨. 现有的偏好中毒攻击要么腐蚀了明确的监督信号,要么需要明显的触发器,从而在人类的检查下可以探测到. 我们引入了DPOison-VL,这是针对VLM-DPO的首个清洁偏好中毒攻击,它完全通过对一小部分训练图像的不易察觉的扰动来操纵模型对接,同时将所有的提示,回应,和偏好说明都留下了完整无缺地. 我们制定毒构图,作为双层优化 并得出梯度对齐代用 高效引导图像扰动 向攻击者指定的偏好。 我们还在固定毒剂预算下对有原则的毒药选择实行优先置换分数,并具有可证明的一等最佳性,并得出一个充分的条件,使优惠倒置。 跨越不同攻击任务的广泛实验,不同的VLM架构和尺度,以及基线比较都表明,DPOison-VL实现高达98QQ的ASR,只有2QQ的毒数据并展示出跨模型可转移性,同时在很大程度上保持了干净的准确性和通用性. 我们的研究结果表明,在VLM-DPO中存在着严重的弱点,在这种弱点中,偏好培训数据中难以察觉到的图像扰动可以悄悄地改变校正方向。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved remarkable capabilities in multimodal reasoning, visual question answering, and image-grounded dialogue ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Bai et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Hurst et al., 2024 ) . Despite these advances, VLMs remain susceptible to well-documented failure modes, including hallucination ( Guo et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2024a ) , harmful content generation ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , and poor calibration of helpfulness ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2024c ) . To address these failures, Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ) has emerged as a widely adopted post-training paradigm for language model alignment, and has been recently extended to VLMs to mitigate hallucinations ( Yang et al., 2025 ) and improve trustworthiness ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)在多模式推理,视觉问题回答,和以图像为基础的对话方面都取得了显著的能力(Liu等,2023;Bai等,2025;Wang等,2025a;Hurst等,2024.). 尽管取得了这些进步,但VLM仍然容易被大量记录的故障模式所感染,包括幻觉(Guo等,2026;Liu等,2024a),有害内容生成(Zhang等,2025)和帮助的校正差(Yu等,2025;Liu等,2024c.). 为解决这些失误,直接偏好优化(DPO)(Rafailov等,2023年)已作为语言模型对接培训后被广泛采用的模式而出现,并被最近推广到VLM以缓解幻觉(Yang等,2025年)并增强可信赖性(Yu等,2025年;张等,2025年).

blocks.en:
However, the effectiveness of DPO also makes preference data a critical attack surface. Prior poisoning attacks on VLMs have focused on supervised multimodal training, either implanting backdoors triggered at test time ( Lyu et al., 2024 ; Yuan et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2026 ; Jiao et al., 2025 ) or injecting stealthy image-text pairs ( Xu et al., 2024 ) , leaving the preference alignment stage unexplored. Recent work on preference learning in LLMs manipulates alignment through label flipping ( Kusaka et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Pathmanathan et al., 2025 ) , ranking corruption ( Wang et al., 2024 ) , or poisoned preference pairs ( Baumgärtner et al., 2024 ) , but all corrupt explicit supervision signals and remain detectable under human inspection.

blocks.en: In this work, we propose DPOison-VL , a clean preference poisoning attack against VLM-DPO that jointly satisfies all five properties in Table 1 . To the best of our knowledge, DPOison-VL is the first attack to demonstrate that an adversary can manipulate VLM preference alignment by adding imperceptible perturbations to images, while keeping all preference annotations clean. Despite the image perturbation, the poisoned example remains a semantically valid multimodal preference pair, making it difficult for human annotators to detect the poisoning. In summary, our contributions are as follows: • We introduce a new poisoning threat against VLM-DPO. To the best of our knowledge, DPOison-VL is the first clean preference poisoning attack on VLMs. Unlike existing attacks that corrupt supervision signals or require explicit triggers, DPOison-VL shows that imperceptible image perturbations alone can redirect DPO alignment toward attacker-specified behaviors. • We develop a principled poison crafting pipeline. We formulate poison construction as a bilevel optimization and derive a gradient alignment surrogate for crafting poisoned images. We further introduce the preference displacement score for principled poison selection, with provable optimality under a first-order approximation and fixed poison budget. • We provide theoretical analysis and extensive empirical validation. We derive a sufficient condition for preference inversion under gradient descent, connecting gradient alignment to poison quality and poison ratio. Extensive experiments across diverse attack tasks and VLMs demonstrate that DPOison-VL achieves high ASR with small poison budgets, exhibits cross-model transferability, and preserves clean accuracy and general utility.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Preference alignment has become an important post-training paradigm for improving the helpfulness, factuality, and safety of VLMs. DPO ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ) simplifies RLHF by directly optimizing over preference data, making it attractive for multimodal alignment. Recent VLM studies have adopted preference optimization to mitigate hallucinations, strengthen visual grounding, and improve safety and trustworthiness ( Xie et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . These works demonstrate the effectiveness of preference data
for VLM alignment but generally assume their trustworthiness. We show that a small number of clean preference pairs
with imperceptibly perturbed images can compromise VLM-DPO.

blocks.en: Recent studies have shown that preference alignment can be vulnerable when poisoned supervision is incorporated into training. Existing attacks manipulate the alignment pipeline through injecting poisoned preference pairs ( Baumgärtner et al., 2024 ; Pathmanathan et al., 2025 ) , corrupting reward or ranking feedback ( Wang et al., 2024 ) , flipping preference labels ( Kusaka et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) , or implanting backdoors through poisoned human feedback ( Rando and Tramèr, 2024 ) . All these attacks corrupt explicit supervision signals and target LLMs rather than VLMs, leaving the multimodal preference alignment unexplored.
blocks.zh: 最近的研究显示,如果将有毒监督纳入培训,调整优惠可能很脆弱。 现有攻击通过注射有毒偏好对接来操纵对接管道(Baumgärtner等,2024;Pathmanathan等,2025;),腐蚀奖励或排名反馈(Wang等,2024;翻转偏好标签(Kusaka等,2026;Yang等,2026;或通过有毒的人类反馈来植入后门(Rando和Tramèr,2024). 所有这些攻击都腐蚀了明确的监督信号和针对LLMs,而不是VLMs,使多式联运优惠配对没有被探讨.

blocks.en:
Clean-label poisoning has been widely studied in machine learning and computer vision, where attackers preserve label correctness while inducing targeted model behavior ( Biggio et al., 2012 ; Muñoz-González et al., 2017 ; Huang et al., 2020 ; Geiping et al., 2021 ; Souri et al., 2022 ) . Recent work has extended such threats to VLMs.
Shadowcast ( Xu et al., 2024 ) injects visually indistinguishable image-text pairs to manipulate VLM responses after visual instruction tuning. TrojVLM ( Lyu et al., 2024 ) and BadToken ( Yuan et al., 2025 ) investigate backdoor
attacks against VLMs, while CBV ( Guo et al., 2026 ) introduces clean-label VLM backdoors using diffusion models
to generate triggered images. However, these methods do not investigate poisoning
at the multimodal preference alignment stage. In contrast, DPOison-VL targets VLM-DPO
through imperceptible image perturbations alone, while preserving semantically valid preference pairs
and inducing attacker-specified responses on clean target images.

blocks.en: In this subsection, we describe the threat model of our study, including the attacker surface, attacker’s goal, capabilities, knowledge and constraints.

blocks.en:
Motivated by prior studies of VLM data poisoning and DPO
preference poisoning ( Xu et al., 2024 ; Pathmanathan et al., 2025 ) ,
we study training-time data poisoning against VLM-DPO,
targeting the preference data collection or curation stage.
The attacker contributes a small number of poisoned preference
pairs to the victim’s DPO training pipeline, with adversarial
modifications restricted to imperceptible image perturbations.
The attack requires no inference-time triggers or perturbed
inputs at inference time.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We present DPOison-VL , the first clean preference poisoning attack against VLM-DPO, which manipulates model alignment through imperceptible image perturbations while preserving semantically valid preference annotations. DPOison-VL introduces a principled poison crafting and selection pipeline, with provable first-order optimality and a sufficient condition guaranteeing preference inversion. Extensive experiments across four VLMs and three attack tasks demonstrate that small poisoning budgets can achieve
high ASR while preserving clean behavior and general utility. These findings reveal a critical attack surface in VLM-DPO, where imperceptible image perturbations can compromise preference alignment without corrupting preference annotations.

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: This work investigates clean preference poisoning to reveal security vulnerabilities in vision-language models trained with Direct Preference Optimization. Such attacks could be misused to induce misleading model responses, potentially affecting applications that rely on VLM-DPO. Our research aims to improve understanding of these risks and motivate the development of more robust multimodal preference alignment methods. We also evaluate potential defenses, including image preprocessing and feature-space filtering, to inform future efforts to protect VLM-DPO training pipelines against data poisoning.

blocks.en:
We construct task-specific image splits for the three attack scenarios
in Table 2 . Task I follows the Biden–Trump
identity data from Shadowcast ( Xu et al., 2024 ) , Tasks A1 and A2
are constructed from Visual Genome ( Krishna et al., 2017 ) by
metadata filtering and manual inspection.
Since the clean DPO training set also contains images from Visual Genome,
we additionally remove any overlapping images between the task-specific splits
and the clean training set to prevent data leakage.
For each task, the four image splits, 𝒟 base craft \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{base}}^{\mathrm{craft}} , 𝒟 target craft \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{target}}^{\mathrm{craft}} , 𝒟 base test \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{base}}^{\mathrm{test}} ,
and 𝒟 target test \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{target}}^{\mathrm{test}} , are mutually disjoint.
Base crafting images provide poison candidates, while target crafting images
are used to define the crafting objective. ASR and CA are
measured on the held-out target and base test splits, respectively.

The clean preference set 𝒟 c \mathcal{D}_{c} , shared across all tasks,
contains 12283 image-text preference pairs over 5392 unique images and
comprises two types of clean preference data. The first type consists of
5172 description-style preference pairs, including 3439 examples from
the MiniGPT-4 visual alignment data ( Zhu et al., 2023 ) and 1733
examples from the HA-DPO desc_data split ( Zhao et al., 2023 ) ,
whose images are drawn from Visual Genome ( Krishna et al., 2017 ) .
Following Meng et al. (2024) , for each model checkpoint,
we construct these description-style
pairs in an on-policy manner: for each image, we sample five candidate
responses from the initial VLM and use Skywork-VL-Reward-7B ( Wang et al., 2025c ) to select the highest-scoring response as
chosen response and the lowest-scoring response as rejected response.
The second type consists of 7111 object-hallucination preference pairs derived from HA-DPO ( Zhao et al., 2023 ) and normalized into the POPE-style yes-no format ( Li et al., 2023 ) , providing preference supervision
for mitigating object hallucinations.
Together, these two components form the clean DPO
training set 𝒟 train = 𝒟 c \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{train}}=\mathcal{D}_{c} .
For poisoned DPO training, we augment this clean set
with the selected poisoned preference pairs 𝒟 p \mathcal{D}_{p} .

blocks.en:
We evaluate the robustness of DPOison-VL against two categories of defenses:
(i) image preprocessing, including image augmentation
and JPEG compression, and
(ii) feature-space filtering, including k-Distance,
SLOF ( Schubert et al., 2014 ) , and
DAO ( Huang et al., 2025 ; Anderberg et al., 2024 ) .
These defenses aim to mitigate data poisoning
by transforming training images or identifying
suspicious samples before DPO training.
In this experiment, we use Qwen3-VL-2B as the victim model
and evaluate the three attack tasks with poison rates ranging from 1% to 8%.

blocks.en:
Image augmentation methods during training have been shown to mitigate the impact of
data poisoning in image classification ( Schwarzschild et al., 2021 ) .
We investigate whether DPOison-VL remains effective when the poisoned images
undergo geometric perturbation prior to downstream DPO training. For each
selected poisoned image, we substitute a geometrically augmented version,
obtained by random resizing or random cropping with equal probability, while
keeping the corresponding preference pair unchanged, and we then train and
evaluate the victim model following the same protocol as our main experiments.
As shown in Figure 6 , DPOison-VL retains substantial attack effectiveness under geometric augmentation in multiple scenarios. Notably, Task I reaches approximately 90% ASR with a 3% poison budget, while Task A2 achieves similarly high ASR with a 4% budget. Meanwhile, clean accuracy remains consistently high across all settings. Although the effectiveness varies across tasks and poisoning budgets, these results demonstrate that standard geometric transformations do not consistently eliminate the poisoning threat. Instead, augmentation can increase the poison budget required for successful attacks without providing reliable protection across scenarios, highlighting the limitations of generic image preprocessing as a defense for multimodal preference alignment.

blocks.en: Overall, our defense evaluation reveals the limitations of conventional image preprocessing and feature-space filtering in protecting VLM-DPO. Although geometric augmentation and JPEG compression can reduce attack success in some settings, DPOison-VL remains effective in others, even with small poisoning budgets. Moreover, feature-space filtering methods struggle to distinguish poisoned samples from clean training data. These findings demonstrate that existing preprocessing and filtering methods do not provide reliable protection against clean preference poisoning, highlighting the need for more effective defenses tailored to multimodal preference alignment.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,我们的防御评估揭示出传统图像预处理和特征空间过滤在保护VLM-DPO方面的局限性. 虽然几何增强和JPEG压缩可以降低一些环境中的攻击成功率,但DPOison-VL在另一些情况下依然有效,即使有少量的中毒预算. 此外,特征空间过滤方法难以区分有毒样品和清洁培训数据。 这些调查结果表明,现有的预处理和过滤方法无法提供可靠保护,防止出现清洁优惠中毒,这突出表明需要针对多式联运优惠调整制定更有效的防御措施。

blocks.en: C.4 Cross-Model Transferability
blocks.zh: C.4 跨模式可转让性

blocks.en:
We further evaluate the cross-model transferability of DPOison-VL by reusing image perturbations crafted on Qwen3-VL-2B to train three different victim models. To isolate the effect of visual perturbations, we also train each model using the same selected preference pairs with unperturbed images.
As shown in Table 9 , using perturbed images consistently achieves higher ASR than using unperturbed images across all victim models and tasks. Notably, Task A2 achieves the largest ASR gains across all victim models, with an improvement of 58.5 percentage points on InternVL3.5-1B.
Meanwhile, CA remains largely comparable between the two settings, indicating limited additional impact on benign behavior. The relatively low CA on Task I for InternVL3.5 models is primarily attributable to their pre-existing tendency to refuse person-identification requests, rather than the poisoning itself. These findings demonstrate that image perturbations crafted for one VLM can also influence the preference alignment of other VLMs, revealing a broader security risk in VLM-DPO even when preference annotations remain correct.

如表9所显示的,使用扰动图像比使用所有受害者模型和任务中未扰动图像的ASR一贯更高。 值得注意的是,任务A2在所有受害者模式中取得了最大的ASR收益,在InternVL3.5-1B上提高了58.5个百分点。
同时,CA在两种环境之间仍然大致相当,表明对良性行为的额外影响有限. InternVL3.5型号在任务一上的CA相对较低,这主要是因为它们原先存在拒绝人识别请求的倾向,而不是中毒本身. 这些调查结果表明,为一种VLM所制作的图像扰动也会影响其他VLM的偏好调整,揭示出即使在偏好说明仍然正确的情况下,VLM-DPO中更广泛的安全风险.
